# skycloak_cluster_insights (Data Source)

Cluster analytics returned as a raw JSON document. Decode with `jsondecode()`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster_insights" "overview" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  type       = "overview"
}

output "insights" {
  value = jsondecode(data.skycloak_cluster_insights.overview.json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `type` (String) Insight type: `overview`, `authentication`, `events`, `performance`, or `security`.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The analytics document as a JSON string.
